baseline_models.mechanism: The negated capacity construction binds practical ability directly to n-s-r: the expected helpers cannot execute the aid or ascendancy sought from them.

activation_trace.role: Capacity and practical enablement are explicitly negated, making non-performance the governing mechanism.
Aid that makes another prevail supplies the precise action that the supposed patrons cannot perform.

changed_reading.before: The gods do not help their worshippers.
changed_reading.after: The entities recruited as helpers lack executable capacity to make their dependents prevail.

baseline_models.mechanism: The circumstantial clause reverses the expected support direction: those seeking help form the collected, mutually supporting force for the very patrons that cannot help them.

activation_trace.role: A collected body of mutual supporters turns the human group into the patrons' manpower.
Obedience and following expose the asymmetry between the patrons' incapacity and the followers' service.
Mutual aid is expected from the patrons but is supplied socially in the opposite direction by their host.

changed_reading.before: A powerless object has an army standing nearby.
changed_reading.after: The supposed beneficiaries of divine aid have become an obedient support-corps for powerless patrons.

baseline_models.mechanism: The army noun joined to the passive participial مُحْضَرُونَ depicts a collective caused to be present. Its assembly can therefore signal custody or compulsory muster, not merely voluntary readiness.

activation_trace.role: The mutually supporting collective supplies the body that is mustered.
Presence, arrival, and proximity give the passive form its basic caused-attendance image.
A gathered group brought for an expedition sharpens attendance into organized muster.

changed_reading.before: Their army is present for them.
changed_reading.after: A collective has been marshalled into attendance by an unstated summoning power, so its presence suggests custody as well as deployment.

baseline_models.mechanism: The verse sets unavailable action against over-available personnel: help cannot be produced, yet a whole host is already made present. The failure is therefore not lack of followers but the patrons' intrinsic incapacity.

activation_trace.role: Practical capacity is absent on the patrons' side.
Numerous organized supporters make shortage of manpower an unavailable explanation.
Their already-realized presence contrasts with the aid that never becomes real.

changed_reading.before: The attempted rescue happens to fail.
changed_reading.after: Even maximal follower availability cannot compensate for the patrons' intrinsic inability to act.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, no heavenly army is sent down; one cry alone resolves the confrontation. Against that economy of action, the powerless patrons' dependence on a human army marks derivative, parasitic power rather than strength.

activation_trace.role: The focus host is a collected support body whose apparent force is being reassessed.
The same army image is explicitly denied as a necessary heavenly instrument.
A single alarming cry supplies effective action without deployment of a supporting host.
Numerical oneness concentrates efficacy in one event and exposes the later army's excess without power.

structural_cues: 36:28 explicitly negates descent of a jund, and 36:29 immediately supplies one decisive cry.
The same j-n-d focus inventory resolves both the earlier denied army and the focus army.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies no heavenly army followed by one effective cry. I infer a contrast between self-sufficient command and patrons dependent on followers; the live alternative is that 36:28 only describes that episode's economy.

changed_reading.before: The army in 36:75 is merely unable to secure victory.
changed_reading.after: Its very necessity indicts the false patrons: true efficacy needed no army, while powerless patrons consume human mobilization.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact مُحْضَرُونَ formula elsewhere brings everyone before the divine presence, followed by recompense and separation. The focus army consequently reads as a cohort already designated for presentation and sorting, not as a force free to maneuver.

activation_trace.role: Presence in contention before authority makes the passive muster potentially juridical.
The repeated passive plural explicitly locates universal caused-presence before the divine.
Gathering dispersed persons supplies the assembly operation behind the focus muster.
A second exact مُحْضَرُونَ recurrence fixes the destination as presence before Us.
Recompense following the gathering turns presentation into accountable review.
Separation and sorting show that the gathered mass will be classified rather than deployed.

structural_cues: 36:32, 36:53, and 36:75 all end with the same passive plural مُحْضَرُونَ.
The 36:53 presentation is followed by recompense in 36:54 and separation in 36:59.
The passive form leaves the host under an external power of summons.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated caused-presence, universal gathering, recompense, and sorting. I infer that 36:75's cohort is under judgment summons; a live alternative is a broader eschatological assembly without specifically juridical force.

changed_reading.before: The worshippers are presently stationed as their gods' defenders.
changed_reading.after: They are a docketed cohort, marshalled with their patrons toward presentation, recompense, and separation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly tests substitute powers across intercession, extraction from danger, and answered distress. Every rescue route fails before 36:74 names the hope of n-s-r, so 36:75 closes an accumulated rescue audit rather than making one battlefield claim.

activation_trace.role: Aid and making another prevail name the umbrella function denied in the focus.
A mediator joining another's cause supplies the legal-relational rescue route that proves useless.
Extraction from a peril or another's grip supplies concrete rescue that the deities cannot perform.
Answering a distress call supplies emergency aid whose absence exposes total dependency.
Repeated non-extraction extends failure from intercession to physical crisis.
The immediately preceding hope for aid makes the focus denial the explicit verdict on all substitute rescue.

structural_cues: 36:23 and 36:43 repeat negated rescue constructions before 36:74-75 repeats the same expectation and denial.
The focus follows directly after the stated motive that the adopted gods might give aid.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed intercession, failed extraction, unanswered distress, and the final hope for n-s-r. I infer a cumulative functional audit; the live alternative is to keep each failure local to its scene.

changed_reading.before: The gods cannot provide military support.
changed_reading.after: No substitute patron can intervene at any layer, whether by advocacy, extraction, emergency answer, or victory.

context_deltas.mechanism: The covenant forbids enslaved worship of a named enemy who has already led a vast multitude astray. The focus jund can therefore be heard as an enemy's captured social force: worship has organized the misled mass into service for powerless patrons.

activation_trace.role: The collected mutually supporting host supplies the organized human force being socially reassigned.
Submissive worship supplies the service relation that turns affiliation into conscription.
The rebellious adversarial figure supplies the hostile command pole of the misdirected service.
Explicit enmity prevents the service relation from being read as benign allegiance.
A mountain-like multitude supplies the mass from which the focus host can be constituted.
Numerical dominance sharpens the host as large-scale captured allegiance rather than isolated error.

structural_cues: 36:60-62 moves from forbidden worship of an enemy to the enemy's misleading of a great multitude.
36:75 then names a collected supporting host using the same social field of service and opposition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enemy-directed worship and a vast misled multitude. I infer that jund names the organized result of that allegiance; a live alternative is that the army exists only at final presentation, not as a present cultic corps.

changed_reading.before: The worshippers happen to stand with their gods.
changed_reading.after: Misdirected worship has conscripted a vast human collective into an enemy-aligned support structure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, humans own livestock made tractable for their use; they then adopt gods for support and become those gods' host. The owner-user relation flips: people who receive subjected creatures subject themselves as usable manpower.

activation_trace.role: Obedience supplies the relational hinge by which users of subjected creatures become followers in service.
The collected support force is the human utility extracted by the powerless patrons.
Livestock supplies the concrete class over which humans are said to exercise use and possession.
Ownership and disposal establish the first direction of the user-used relation.
Making a difficult creature tractable supplies the subjection image that is socially reversed in the focus.
The expectation of aid motivates the adoption that immediately reverses who serves whom.

structural_cues: 36:71-75 is a contiguous progression from ownership, subjection, and use to adopted patrons, hoped-for aid, and human jund.
Repeated لهم and لها constructions keep reallocating benefit and service among God, humans, animals, and adopted gods.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tractable livestock, human ownership, adopted gods, and a human host for them. I infer an owner-used reversal; a live alternative is a simpler contrast between divine benefits and human ingratitude without a domestication analogy.

changed_reading.before: Humans foolishly defend the gods they expect to defend them.
changed_reading.after: After receiving creatures made usable for them, humans invert the gift by making themselves usable stock for powerless patrons.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated inability prevents a final instruction, forward motion, return, and finally aid. The closing sequence answers with the Creator's capability, an order whose utterance realizes existence, universal sovereignty, and compelled return. Capacity is thus jurisdictional and performative, not merely muscular.

activation_trace.role: Negated practical capacity anchors the contrast with commands that do take effect.
The same inability formula blocks even the execution of a final instruction.
A transmitted directive supplies a human command that sudden judgment prevents from taking effect.
Repeated inability under imposed transformation shows capacity as held under a superior will.
Failure to pass forward gives the abstract incapacity a concrete blocked trajectory.
Effective power reaching action and dominion supplies the affirmative counterpart to inability.
Binding command supplies authority whose directive does not remain merely verbal.
Occurrence and presence immediately realize the command, contrasting with aid that cannot be realized.
Universal sovereignty identifies the jurisdiction within which capacity, command, and return operate.

structural_cues: The same s-t-ṭ-y-ʿ inability formula occurs at 36:50, 36:67, and 36:75.
36:81 answers with capability, 36:82 with an effective command, and 36:83 with sovereignty and return.
Human directives and movement are interruptible; the divine directive is represented as self-realizing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated blocked human action and a closing capable command that becomes reality. I infer a contrast of jurisdictions and performative efficacy; a live alternative is a simpler omnipotence contrast without emphasis on command structure.

changed_reading.before: The false gods lack enough strength to help.
changed_reading.after: They lack effective jurisdiction: their desired aid cannot enter reality, whereas the sovereign command executes itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: Bodily testimony, the human as manifest adversary, and his produced argument activate the litigation branch of h-d-r. The mustered jund can therefore function as a collective party brought into contention, with its own members and bodies becoming evidence.

activation_trace.role: Presence in contest and dispute before authority turns the muster into a possible hearing.
The collected host supplies the corporate party produced at that hearing.
Testimony that discloses with knowledge supplies the evidentiary procedure surrounding presentation.
Open disputation supplies the adversarial stance taken by the human party after the focus.
Producing and displaying an argument by example supplies the litigant's pleaded case.

structural_cues: 36:65 stages testimony by hands and feet while mouths are sealed.
Immediately after the focus, concealed and public speech is known, the human appears as a manifest opponent, and he advances an example.
The h-d-r inventory itself includes contention before a ruler or judge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily testimony, adversarial dispute, argument, and a h-d-r litigation branch. I infer a corporate party brought to hearing; a live alternative is that these are separate judgment and resurrection scenes with no courtroom extension into 36:75.

changed_reading.before: The host is gathered as military manpower.
changed_reading.after: The host is also a corporate litigant brought before authority, where its own members become evidence against its allegiance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates n-s-r's rain and water-channel branches and h-d-r's return-to-water branch inside an apparently military sentence. It remains valid because all three branches attach to focus words and the surah supplies bursting springs, benefits, and drinking places immediately relevant to provision. Render it only as an exploratory material analogy, never as a replacement for the dominant aid and muster senses.

activation_trace.role: Rain as relief lets denied n-s-r register as failure to supply life-giving material aid.
Channels arriving from afar toward collected water model an aid network that should conduct provision.
Return to a watering place turns the host's attendance into recurrent dependence at a provision node.
Wide bursting open supplies the release mechanism by which real provision reaches the landscape.
A flowing water source supplies the productive node absent from the false patrons' network.
Concrete benefit makes provision an active local concern immediately before the adoption of gods.
Drinking places and their instruments activate the focus branch of returning to water.

changed_reading.before: The patrons fail to send military help although followers assemble for them.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the patrons are dead provision nodes: they cannot channel sustaining relief, yet dependents repeatedly gather back to them as though to a watering place.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's secondary s-ṭ-ʿ mapping for the focus root and reads spatial projection through a capacity form. It remains anchored in يَسْتَطِيعُونَ and gains a visible contrast from the later extraction and ignition of fire. Downstream prose must label it a form-distant spatial metaphor, not an alternate morphology or a claim that the verb literally means to shine.

activation_trace.role: Extension and rising into the air let failed capacity be visualized as force that cannot project beyond its source.
Blazing fire supplies a later image of power made manifest from an unlikely material source.
Actual ignition provides the effective outward realization that the false patrons cannot produce.

changed_reading.before: The false gods cannot perform the requested act.
changed_reading.after: As a contained spatial metaphor, their force has no reach or ignition: it cannot rise into effective projection even with a host on display.

strongest_changes: The human army becomes evidence of reversed dependency: those seeking support are the usable support-base of powerless patrons.
Repeated مُحْضَرُونَ elsewhere shifts the host from voluntary deployment toward compelled presentation, recompense, and sorting.
The denied army and single cry, followed by capable self-realizing command, contrast follower-dependent power with sovereign efficacy.
The contiguous livestock sequence turns the focus into an owner-used reversal in which users of subjected creatures subject themselves.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence made the focus lexemes do more than restate impotence: j-n-d was first denied as a necessary instrument, h-d-r repeatedly marked universal presentation, and ṭ-w-ʿ inability was bracketed by blocked human acts and an effective divine command. The immediate 36:71-75 sequence then supplied a concrete social-material reversal.
remaining_uncertainties: The pronoun allocation in وَهُمْ لَهُمْ permits different emphases on which group is the host and for whom it is marshalled.
مُّحْضَرُونَ can foreground present attendance, compulsory muster, or eschatological presentation; the context strongly activates the last two without eliminating the first.
The provision-circuit and failed-projection readings are intentionally branch-distant and should remain exploratory beside the dominant aid, allegiance, and judgment models.
